module: Pause menu data provider for the Environment page: summary (weather, traffic, others), weather/time page, simulation page (gravity, speed) and traffic page. It decides whether editing is allowed (freeroam, multiplayer, freeroamTutorial, or if the restrictScenarios setting is disabled) and takes the First Drive session's capabilities into account. Mods can add buttons to the page via the hook onEnvironmentGetOtherButtons.
notes: The hook onEnvironmentGetOtherButtons(candidates, actionState) is only emitted if showOther is true (so not during a First Drive session). Each candidate button must have id, label and callback, otherwise an error is logged and it is ignored; icon and routeTarget are optional.
The "other" buttons are sorted by label (string comparison); the Simulation button is one of them.
getEnvironmentWeatherData and getEnvironmentTrafficData call core_environment without a nil check (getTimeOfDayOptions, getInitState).

getEnvironmentData.desc: Returns the Environment summary page: PauseEnvironmentDigest component with weather, traffic and other buttons (simulation included), action states, time of day options, the level's initial values and the current level name.

getEnvironmentWeatherData.desc: Returns the weather/time page (PauseEnvironmentWeather component) with gravityPresets, simSpeedPresets, timeOfDayOptions and levelDefaults from core_environment.

returns.desc: {editable, disabledReason, mainCardClass, mainPanelContent, gravityPresets, simSpeedPresets, timeOfDayOptions, levelDefaults}

getEnvironmentSimulationData.desc: Returns the simulation page (PauseEnvironmentSimulation component). During a First Drive session, returns an empty non-editable page.

getEnvironmentTrafficData.desc: Returns the traffic page (PauseEnvironmentTraffic component) with the data from ui_pause_providers_trafficControls.getData({editable = ...}).

requestEnvironmentTrafficPayload.desc: Redirects to ui_pause_providers_trafficControls.getData(payload), to refresh only the traffic data.
